The episode also argues that Rockstar’s lack of a simultaneous PC release and limited physical availability contribute to preservation concerns. The creator does not endorse piracy and says he plans to purchase the PC edition. His forecast that development may advance rapidly, possibly by year’s end, remains speculative and is based on the reported activity of these projects.
